verdict.rationale: Elicit is a SaaS research product, so open-sourcing its code is a fair axis to judge it on. However, no evidence item mentions a source repository, a public codebase or an open-source license. A published OpenAPI spec, an API and an MCP server are adjacent openness features and do not make the product's source readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
